notes.title: First Content Update for Seeds of Calamity!
notes.notes:
Hello! Today I’m here to announce the first official content update for Seeds of Calamity!

 

Introducing the Sky Pheasant and Wooly Boar! Starting in Year 2, talk to Finn to purchase these new adorable farm animals. They can be housed in the existing pens but keep in mind that each pen can only hold 4 animals.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41312751/bfaad514d59b94f9ff62e54b4d0d8ea80eda52eb.png"]

Refine Wool and Fur with the Spinning Wheel! You can now refine the wool you get from Snowtop Sheep and Wooly Boars to make it more valuable in the same way that Pickling Vessels work for Rock Hen Eggs (and now Sky Pheasant Eggs!).

But how can you get your hands on this new device? Keep an eye on your mailbox! Once you have repaired the Ritual Stone on the farm and have purchased your first Snowtop Sheep, you will receive a letter from Yri who has an interesting book for you… 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41312751/17683cd311481eb0f17226dceb28844b589500bf.png"]



New Egg, New Recipes! With the new Sky Egg animal product, comes new cooking recipes! You can now purchase the Poached Eggs recipe during the Rock Hen Carnival. And after buying your first Sky Pheasant, Helena will want a word with you…

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41312751/610d98aeb305a8e87a281ba99b289dccf3558e4c.png"]

 

View Shrine Offerings from Anywhere! You can now view all shrine offerings from your Journal menu in the Achievements section.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41312751/9d9d029951495285c3801b209b2f0188308db8a6.png"]

 

New Adorable Companion! With this update I have also added a new companion type: Snowtop Sheep. You can change your companion at any time by using the mirror in your farmhouse. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41312751/6d74deee99d62600a0e5573c093adb949739c669.png"] 

Thank you for all your feedback and I hope you enjoy this new content. <3

With this update I also did a bunch of bug fixes and other minor feature changes:

Game Play: 

You will now be able to interact with everything inside of the farmhouse while the internal storage is being upgraded.

The chest behind the waterfall south of the farm can now only be opened once.

Fixed a cutscnene with Jorund from being triggered too many times.

Fixed the shrine interior display for some players that only have 1 offering left to complete.

Placing fertilizer in the rain will maintain the watered state as expected when returning to your farm.

Smoothed a quest interaction with Lady Valeska when upgrading your Ritual Stone.

Fixed a bugged fishing spot on Jorund's island.

 Dungeon: 

Missing a fishing catch in the dungeon will no longer count towards the fishing spot. So now you can catch 3 fish at each spot even if you miss.

Using a pickaxe on tilled dirt no longer costs energy.

Fixed an exploit with the minecart treasure chest puzzle.

 UI and Controller Support: 

Some players were able to buy Quality Hay before unlocking Coarse Hay. This has been fixed.

You will now no longer loose geodes when placing geodes from a different level in the same slot when breaking geodes at the crafting bench.

You will no longer lose a book if you turn in multiple books at once to the bookshelf in your farmhouse.

Reduced the cost of acorns and pinecones in the general store to 100 instead of 200 gold.

Added more spacing between characters for all hi definition fonts to increase readability, especially when entering animal names.

Fixed a bad interaction with tree tappers and the animal pen when using tools with controller.

 Crafting Changes: 

Reduced the Gold Bar recipe to use 1 less ore and 1 less Attuned Crystal, bringing it in line with the Iron Bar.

Reduced the Platinum Bar recipe to only need 1 Enhanced Crystal.

All Ritual Stone crafts should now craft much faster.



Talk to you soon,
Jenny

notes.title: Return Crystal and Accessibility Patch (0.10.16.7)
notes.notes:
Hello! Here is the next patch for Seeds of Calamity. I added a few new accessibility features on top of a large list of bug fixes.


Important Changes!
You can get a new Return Crystal from the Combat Altar in the Shrine if the original one you received, has disappeared.

There is a new "Teleport Home" option in the Accessibility menu. This will teleport you back to your farmhouse but time will move forward to night time. This is ideal if you get soft locked in the dungeon combat or stuck on bad environmental collisions.


Accessibility Features:

There is a new "Pause When Window is Unfocused" option in the Accessibility menu. When turned on, the game will pause when the game window is unfocused or tabbed away. This is off by default.

There is a new "Prompt When Ending Combat Turns" option in the Accessibility menu. When turned on, the game will prompt you when you try to end a combat turn while still having action points left. This is off by default. 



 Gameplay: 

 Removed a floating artifact spot on the island below Jorund's house.

All seed prices will be whole numbers even if the seed price reduction perk has been selected.

Fixed the double fish skilling perk not working for some players.

Watered dirt is now visually darker to improve the distinction between hoed and watered dirt.

Having a full pack will no longer break the One Small Favor quest when talking to Ingrid.



 Combat and Dungeon Exploration: 

Made all dungeon door cutscenes unskippable to prevent the player from getting suck in doorways.

Completed bounties should now always give the correct amount of gold after sleeping.

Fixed a softlock that could occur when using the Chain Lightning spell.

Changed the third level dungeon bounty request to be the Painted Long Horn bug instead of the Golden Ruff bug.

Fixed a softlock that could occur if a sleeping enemy was healed by another enemy.



 UI and Controller Support: 

The control icons for the hud action bar are shown consistently for both mouse and keyboard and controller.

Prevent accidentally losing a quest item if you try to drop it from your inventory.

Fixed a display issue when trying to read a book too late at night when using a controller.

Fixed an issue where money would display wrong with a decimal point.

Improved Chinese and German localization.



Thank you to everyone who has reported bugs and feedback. <3 



Talk to you soon,
Jenny

notes.title: Patch Version 0.10.16.5
notes.notes:
Hello! I've been working hard this past week to fix as many bugs as possible. I'll be putting out another bug fix patch soon but here is what is in today's patch.

Change log:

Gameplay:

 Farming exp balance changes.
 The game will now default to the language of your Steam Client if the game has support for that language.
 The barrel to the right of the fireplace in the farmhouse has been removed. This was causing some items to get stuck after they had finished crafting.
 Fixed the seed prices in the general store from being calculated incorrectly after taking the seed price reduction perk.
 Updated the sprites for the outfit top when walking to no longer have missing pixels.
 I removed the option to buy the Light Chair and Table in the Midsummer Fair. This was a mistake on my part. You are supposed to buy these from Ingrid, the travelling merchant. If you have bought the recipe but don't see it in your crafting table, you can safely destroy the recipe item.
 The player should no longer get stuck after leaving chairs in the tavern.
 Opening and placing a small chest should be smoother now.
 You can no longer get infinite rewards from Garin after the Harvest Stew cutscene.
 Fixed festival decorations being visible in the evening if you missed the festival.
 Fixed the pickaxe animation playing on loop after completing a bounty.
 Fixed the Soil Samples in the quest "The Start of a Discovery" from not being accessible when using a controller.
 Some players were unable to play any of the festival mini games, this should now be fixed.


UI and Controller Support:

 The language menu control hint display will now behave as expected.
 Fixed the Return Crystal disappearing when sorting the inventory. I plan to add in the next patch a way for you to get back the Return Crystal if you have lost it.
 Prevented Lady Valeska's tool upgrade menu from showing after you have already upgraded every tool.
 Fixed a display issue when tabbing in the letter menu and Yri's shop with the controller.
 You can no longer open a small chest that has been broken. This is to prevent item loss when storing items in a chest that has been broken.
 Minor text changes.



Thank you to everyone who has reported bugs and feedback. <3 


Talk to you soon,
Jenny

notes.title: Next Fest Update and Discord Announcement
notes.notes:
✨Next Fest is Happening Now!
Seeds of Calamity is in the Steam Next Fest event happening from now until March 3rd. As an indie dev, Steam Next Fest is a big deal and I have been waiting years for this! <3

💙I have a Discord!
As part of the Steam Next Fest I have started a Discord channel for Seeds of Calamity. This channel is a great way to give feedback as well as share your farm creations with others. 

Join the Discord Here!

🌿Playtest 
As a reminder the extended playtest is also still running. Unlike the demo, you can play through 3 full seasons and all 3 levels of the dungeon. I have opened the playtest to everyone so just click the Request Access link on the Steam page to start playing.

🐞Demo and Playtest Change Log
Finally, here are some bug fixes and gameplay updates that I’ve been working on this past week. Thank you to everyone that has been leaving me feedback and bug reports! <3

Gameplay

 The Old Journal from the chest north of the farm will no longer disappear from your inventory after picking it up.
 The game will no longer crash after talking with npcs that are talking with each other.
 Fixed not being able to click the "End Turn" button after casting a spell that has only a chance to hit such as the Thunderstorm spell.
 Fixed not being able to enter the cave below the farm.
 Removing a hoed dirt spot with the pickaxe will display the correct seasonal color.

UI and Controller Support

 You can no longer duplicate items by manipulating the cooking or crafting menus.
 Pressing Escape after loading or saving the game will no longer make the game crash.
 Fixed buying items not displaying correctly after being bought from the tavern or travelling merchant when using a controller.
 Fixed items not stacking correctly when moving then in and out of the farm storage or selling crate.
 Items will now correctly be removed from your inventory when cooking.

Sound and Music

 The music in-game will loop continuously without a delay between songs.



Talk to you soon,
Jenny

notes.title: New Title and Major Demo Update!
notes.notes:
New Title
Pine Lily Village will now be called Seeds of Calamity! This is still the game you’ve always known but the story has been much improved so the title has changed to reflect that.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41312751/2032178696cf3c4ab096333b54f59db8e5cb7575.png

Major Demo Update
Of course, with the new story comes a demo update! There is a new opening cutscene and more fleshed out villager backstories (and a ton of bug fixes). Because of how many changes I’ve made, unfortunately you will not be able to use an old save 

(sorry about that!)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41312751/a524d0314f27f1f1e078db7c2410dc29b6db2612.png

What’s going on?!
So, you might be thinking: “These changes are great and all but what gives? You announce a publisher partnership and then next thing I know you’re changing the title of the game! Seems sus.” 

I assure you, all of the changes to the game have been designed and executed by me. I had actually been considering changing the story of the game before I even met with a publisher and longtime followers will know that I’ve changed the story of the game a few times already. I’ve always loved the characters of the game but struggled with the world building.

So that’s what I’ve changed!
Seeds of Calamity is a JRPG inspired world full of heroes and magic. During a great war between nations, an all-powerful beast called the Great Calamity was summoned. It caused so much devastation, that the two waring nations agreed to a peace treaty. That was 20 years ago and now you are tasked with helping rebuild from that war.

You’ll send supplies back to the main city from your farm to help with the reconstruction efforts. Along the way, you’ll complete quests for the villagers, defeat dangerous creatures in the dungeon, and all other farming sim activities you’ve come to know and love.

I hope you enjoy the new and improved demo. As always, if you have any feedback for the game, feel free to post on the Steam forum or fill out the survey from the main menu of the demo. I read every post and really appreciate it. 😊

Finally, Seeds of Calamity will be participating in the Cozy Quest festival between November 14-17th. So if you’re looking for other great cozy games, stay tuned for tomorrow!

notes.title: Portrait Art Update
notes.notes:
If you’ve played the beta versions of Pine Lily Village last year, you would have seen the old portrait art for the villagers. In my opinion, it was a bit lacking. I did my best but I wasn’t happy with what I could create on my own. 

So, I contacted an artist who agreed to remake all the portraits. She was great to work with and I’m super happy with what she created. The NPC portraits now have greater detail and a larger number of expressions which really brings them to life.

Here are a few of my favorites:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41312751/2cb4a776016531a89c6e12cff5d517af4bc42605.png

Finn is the carpenter and rancher for Pine Lily village. He is very easy going and always happy to help out.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41312751/5d99d3789cef150c2bdf0e6e4e907427ece214e0.png

Helena is the tavern owner and is married to Garin, the chef. She likes to gossip but also enjoys hosting everyone in the tavern in the evening.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41312751/36aabb58d78bc09af48b4838d2689d23f2603c40.png

Lady Valeska is a retired professor from the Arnfell Academy. She is strict but fair and helps the player by creating the spells used in combat.


Talk to you soon,
Jenny

I want to thank everyone who played the demo and especially those who have given feedback and bug reports. It really helps me out and I appreciate everyone’s patience with me as I work to squash any bugs that get reported.

notes.title: Planting and Harvesting Update
notes.notes:
Despite the cold, I’ve been hard at work on Pine Lily Village. Today, I want to talk about a core mechanic of the game: planting and harvesting cops. This may sound simple but it's something you will be doing for a large portion of the game.

To start, you will need to buy seeds from the general store or, if you're lucky, find seasonal “mixed seeds”  when scything grass or chopping trees. Mixed seeds will grow a random crop from the current season.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41312751/089e714732c4db2cec6d3781d5e3604a42abb54c.png

Then you will need to hoe the ground, plant your seeds, and water them. Make sure you water your crops everyday or they won’t grow! If it rains, you can skip watering for that day.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41312751/7570953b7aff642de080f7c918bc6e1b78a6d6a7.gif

Finally, after a set number of days, you will get to harvest the fruits of your labor!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41312751/304023eaff0c09986ddc3c8ea9e56071945f1b7d.gif

Talk to you soon,
Jenny
